tema: Future Decisions — Will vs Going To

cast_dialogue.linea: Two futures, heroes: 'going to' for plans you already made, 'will' for decisions born in the moment and promises of the heart.
The phone is ringing! I'll answer it. ... That was my boss — I'm going to work on Saturday.
Watch out! You're going to spill the milk. Don't worry, I'll clean it.
We've booked the tickets — we're going to travel in July. I think it will be the trip of our lives.
If you visit me, I'll bake your favourite cake. That's a promise, mis héroes.

banco_oraciones.oracion: We're going to travel in July. (plan)
I think it will be a great trip. (prediction/opinion)
Look at the clouds — it's going to rain. (evidence)
We aren't going to stay long.
She won't be late, don't worry.
Will you help me with the bags?
What are you going to do this summer?
Will you come? Yes, I will.
Are you going to travel? No, I'm not.
Will she be late? No, she won't.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: — The phone is ringing! — I'm going to answer it.
banner_diagnostico.opcion_b: — The phone is ringing! — I'll answer it.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Going to: plans decided BEFORE speaking and predictions with present evidence. Will: instant decisions at the moment of speaking, promises, offers, and opinions about the future (I think / I hope / probably).

filas: We're going to travel in July.
I'll help you. I won't forget.
I think it will be great.

ejercicios.pregunta: — The phone is ringing! — I ___ answer it.
We've booked the tickets. We ___ travel in July.
Watch out! You ___ spill the milk.

ejercicios.afirmacion: For plans made before speaking we normally use 'will'.

ejercicios.texto: I think it ___ (be) a great trip. (opinion)
I ___ (not / forget) your birthday. I promise!

ejercicios.respuesta: What are you going to do this summer?

ejercicios.texto_con_error: I will to help you with the bags.
ejercicios.respuesta: I will help you with the bags.

ejercicios.oracion_base: She is going to study medicine.
ejercicios.respuesta: Is she going to study medicine?

ejercicios.pregunta: Write one plan (going to), one promise (will) and one prediction (will/going to).
ejercicios.respuesta: I'm going to visit my grandmother. I'll call her every week. I think it will rain tomorrow.

guion: Sofía: Have you decided about the summer, Ben?
Ben: Yes! We're going to travel in July. We've already booked the tickets.
Sofía: Fantastic! I think it will be the trip of your lives.
Ben: I hope so. Oh — the phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
Sofía: Sure. And watch out with that coffee — you're going to spill it!
Ben: Oops, too late! Don't worry, I'll clean it.
Sofía: And I'll open the windows. Teamwork!

comprension.pregunta: What are Ben's plans for July?

reading.texto: The friends are planning the summer. Sofía and Ben have booked the tickets, so they are going to travel in July. Kenji thinks it will be the trip of their lives, and he promises he will take hundreds of photos. Abuela Carmen says she will bake a goodbye cake for them. Look at those dark clouds, though — it is going to rain before the party ends!

preguntas.afirmacion: The trip in July is already decided.
Kenji promises to bake a cake.
There is evidence that it is going to rain.
